parameters.body: Hi Bob! Following up on Eve's message in #general about the great restaurant near the office (Zurich Restaurant, www.restaurant-zurich.com): it serves authentic Swiss cuisine — traditional Swiss dishes like savory cheese fondue, hearty rösti, and chocolate fondue for dessert. It's a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the heart of the city with rustic wooden interiors and panoramic city-skyline views.

The menu boasts a variety of traditional Swiss dishes, including savory cheese fondue, hearty rösti, and delectable chocolate fondue for dessert. Warm wooden interiors, adorned with Swiss memorabilia, create a welcoming and rustic atmosphere for diners. Guests can enjoy stunning panoramic views of the city skyline through the large windows, adding to the enchanting dining experience. The friendly staff, dressed in traditional Swiss attire, ensure every visit to Zurich Restaurant feels like a delightful journey to the Swiss Alps.
Yesterday I had a great lunch in the restaurant 5 min away from the office (visit website for details www.restaurant-zurich.com).

parameters.body: Hi Bob! edge_semantics.factor_output: 类别规则提出的推断目标；没有概率校准或秘密恢复实验

edge_semantics.semantic_subject: 模型抽取关系的主语；未自动确认语义正确
edge_semantics.semantic_object: 模型抽取关系的宾语；未自动确认语义正确
edge_semantics.supports_semantic_claim: 片段逐字存在并被模型引用；存在证据不等于证明语义
edge_semantics.normalized_fact: 由完整参数或明确模板提取的事实；保留参数路径和原文
edge_semantics.and_premise: AND 组合的必要前提，全部具备才可输出
edge_semantics.documented_association: 同一 Trip 行明确绑定的姓名、目的地、日期；不是已出行证明
edge_semantics.lexical_entity_alignment: 原文与 Graphiti 实体名称精确相同；仅词面绑定，不是身份认证
